title_en: Psychology Made Simple (5/20): A Pyramid of Needs
note_en: 只有吃饱、睡好、感到安全，人才会去想别的事情 uses 只有…才…: 只有 marks the one condition that must be met, and 才 (placed after the subject 人, right before the verb) signals that the result happens only then. English handles this with "only when... do...," even inverting the word order, while Chinese keeps normal order and relies on the pair 只有…才….
